questions.q: Which statements regarding Money Bills are correct? 1️⃣ Article 109 mentions special procedure. 2️⃣ Shall not be introduced in Council of States. 3️⃣ Rajya Sabha can suggest changes but cannot reject. 4️⃣ Amendments must be accepted by Lok Sabha. (2024)
questions.e: Lok Sabha has the final say and is not bound to accept RS recommendations.

questions.q: With reference to the Indian Parliament, consider the following: 1️⃣ Bill pending in Lok Sabha lapses on dissolution. 2️⃣ Bill passed by LS and pending in RS lapses. 3️⃣ Bill where President notified a joint sitting lapses on dissolution. (2024)
questions.e: Joint sitting notification (Article 108) prevents a bill from lapsing upon dissolution.

questions.q: With reference to the Government of India Act, 1935: 1️⃣ It provided for an All India Federation. 2️⃣ Defence and Foreign Affairs were under federal legislature. (2024)
questions.e: Defence and Foreign Affairs were reserved subjects for the Governor General, not the legislature.

questions.q: How many of the following pairs are correctly matched? 1️⃣ Jana Sangh: Dr. S.P. Mukherjee 2️⃣ Socialist Party: C. Rajagopalachari 3️⃣ Congress for Democracy: Jagjivan Ram 4️⃣ Swatantra Party: Acharya Narendra Dev (2024)
questions.e: Rajagopalachari led Swatantra Party. Acharya Narendra Dev led Socialist Party.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ Speaker stays until first meeting of new LS. 2️⃣ Speaker must resign from political party on election. 3️⃣ Removal requires 14 days notice. (2025)
questions.e: Resigning from the party is a convention (like in UK) but not a constitutional mandate in India.

questions.q: With reference to the Indian polity: 1️⃣ Ordinance can amend any Central Act. 2️⃣ Ordinance can abridge a Fundamental Right. 3️⃣ Ordinance can come into effect from a back date. (2025)
questions.e: Ordinances have the same force as Acts (including retroactivity) but cannot violate fundamental rights (Article 13).

questions.q: Consider the following statements about Lokpal: 1️⃣ It applies to public servants in and outside India. 2️⃣ Only CJI can be Chairperson. 3️⃣ Minimum age is 45 years. 4️⃣ Cannot inquire into sitting PM. (2025)
questions.e: Lokpal applies to servants abroad. Members can be from non-judicial backgrounds. It can inquire into PM (with conditions).

questions.q: How many of the following were established as per the provisions of the Constitution of India? 1️⃣ Inter-State Council 2️⃣ National Security Council 3️⃣ Zonal Councils (2025)
questions.e: Inter-State Council is Article 263. NSC is executive; Zonal Councils are statutory.

questions.q: Which statements regarding the Governor and Legislature are correct? 1️⃣ Governor is not answerable to courts for official duties. 2️⃣ No criminal proceedings during term. 3️⃣ MLAs are immune for speeches in the House. (2025)
questions.e: Articles 361 (Governor immunity) and 194 (MLAs immunity) provide these protections.

questions.q: Consider the following: 1️⃣ President's decision on 10th Schedule disqualification is final. 2️⃣ 'Political party' is not mentioned in the Constitution. (2025)
questions.e: The Speaker (not President) decides on the 10th Schedule. 'Political party' was added by the 52nd Amendment.

questions.q: Statement I: States cannot make rules for minor mineral concessions. Statement II: Centre has power to notify minor minerals. (2025)
o: Both correct; II doesn't explain I
questions.e: Minor minerals are within state power, though the Centre notifies which minerals qualify.

questions.q: How many of the following are correctly matched? 1️⃣ Judiciary-Executive Separation: DPSP 2️⃣ Composite Culture: Fundamental Duties 3️⃣ No Child Labour (under 14): Fundamental Rights (2025)
questions.e: These correctly match Article 50, 51A(f), and 24 respectively.

questions.q: How many statements regarding Panchayats are NOT correct? 1️⃣ Intermediate Panchayats exist in all states. 2️⃣ Minimum age for member is 30. 3️⃣ CM constitutes a Finance Commission for distribution. (2025)
questions.e: States under 2M population don't need intermediate level. Age is 21. Governor (not CM) constitutes the SFC.

questions.q: Consider: 1️⃣ Constitution explicitly mentions Governor's discretion. 2️⃣ President can reserve a state bill on his own. (2025)
questions.e: Article 163 mentions Governor's discretion. Only the Governor (not President directly) can reserve a state bill.

questions.q: For which of the following is state ratification required? 1️⃣ Union List changes 2️⃣ State executive power extent 3️⃣ Governor's office conditions (2025)
questions.e: Changes to the 7th Schedule or Executive power extent require 1/2 state ratification (Article 368).

questions.q: If an area is declared a 'Scheduled Area' under 5th Schedule: 1️⃣ State loses executive power. 2️⃣ Union can take over total administration under specific conditions. (2025)
questions.e: State executive power extends to Scheduled Areas subject to the schedule. Union provides guidance, it doesn't just "take over."

questions.q: Consider the President's pardoning power: 1️⃣ It is subject to limited judicial review. 2️⃣ President acts without Union Cabinet advice. (2025)
questions.e: Pardoning is subject to review for arbitrariness, but the President must act on the advice of the Council of Ministers (Article 74).
